nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address staged by transferOwnership and promoted to owner in acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, initialized to 'SMZDM' in the constructor.
Public token name string, initialized to 'SMZDM Token' in the constructor.
Public uint8 token decimals, set to 8 in the constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the initial holder in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of holder address to token balance; mutated by transfer() and transferFrom().
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount of approved allowance; mutated by approve() and transferFrom().
Checked addition helper returning c = a + b with require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a and returning c = a - b.
Checked multiplication helper requiring a == 0 || c / a == b.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0 and returning c = a / b.
Owned contract constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership handover: requires msg.sender == newOwner then promotes newOwner to owner.
Modifier that requires msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function body.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the whole supply to a fixed address and emits Transfer.
Constant function returning _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked arithmetic.
Constant function returning the token balance of tokenOwner.
ERC20 transfer that debits msg.sender, credits 'to' via SafeMath and emits Transfer.
ERC20 approve that sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
ERC20 transferFrom that debits 'from' balance and the msg.sender allowance, credits 'to'.
Constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender then calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) on an untrusted contract.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20 transfer to the owner on an arbitrary token contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances indexing and allowance accounting.
Untrusted external call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after state changes, allowing reentrancy.
Untrusted external call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token contract.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] performed outside SafeMath.
